panel_protocol.limitation: Simulation instrument only; not a substitute for live human studies.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: Panelists independently converged on authorization/governance gaps (3/3), blinding integrity (3/3), and adjudication rule weaknesses (3/3). Divergence on disposition reflects different risk tolerances: information-specialist accepted findings as remediable; screening-reviewer and methodologist required structural remediation before endorsement.
convergence_vectors: Blinding bypass via raw decisions()/history() access
Free-text adjudication rule lacks structural enforcement
divergence_vectors: Severity of missing third-reviewer escalation (major vs minor)
Whether eligibility-version binding requires explicit evidence excerpts

top_critical_findings.description: Systemic authorization bypass: role-gate logic allows unassigned principals to submit, resolve, amend, and rescreen.
Canonical decisions are mutable and deletable; amend_decision overwrites, rescreen_subject removes prior decisions.
EPPI-Reviewer export produces raw JSON serialization, not the schema EPPI-Reviewer expects.
Import functions hardcode exclusion_reason.evidence to None, silently stripping evidence excerpts and calibration data.

panel_disposition.detail: 2 of 3 panelists returned requires_re-evaluation. The panel identifies structural remediation targets in authorization integrity, blinding enforcement, and audit-trail immutability before the workflow can be endorsed. Findings are source-implementation issues, not design defects, and are addressable within Track 07 scope.
